Contact

For  safety inspection training course offerings, availability, and general  information, visit the National Highway Institute’s (NHI’s) website at https://www.nhi.fhwa.dot.gov/ . Alternatively, contact NHI at NHICustomerService@dot.gov or 1-877-558-6873.
